module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Partial Fill with Remainder Lot Slicing
precondition: Master opens 3.0 lots across 4 accounts; LP fills 1.5 lots. Math: 1.5 / 4 = 0.375 lots.
expected: Remainder allocated according to active policy (e.g. +0.01 to two highest equity accounts); sum == 1.50 lots.
coverage_note: Requires LP partial-fill, depth, rejection, or routing fault injection; these dedicated accounts are B-book and no LP simulator was supplied.
